concerns.text: T027 (Fidelity) and T029 (Regression) consume 'human-verified reference descriptions' (FR-004, FR-005) but no task exists to retrieve or generate these references. T006 only loads 'real images'. The data-flow is broken: the consumer (Fidelity) requires an artifact (Reference Text) that is never produced by a preceding task.

T006 and T007 load 'IA-Bench and WISE-Verified' datasets, but T015 (US1) and T024 (US2) only reference processing 'the full dataset' without distinguishing sources. If WISE-Verified requires a different schema or download logic (implied by the dual naming), the foundational loader tasks are insufficient to support the downstream consumer tasks which assume a unified input stream.

T013 (Weighted Average Formula) produces the Ambiguity Score, but no task explicitly defines the normalization logic to guarantee the [0.0, 1.0] range required by FR-001. Downstream tasks (T019 Router) depend on strict thresholds (<0.2, >0.6). Without a task ensuring the output is bounded, the consumer (Router) may receive out-of-bounds data, violating the producer-consumer contract.

T020 (Expansion) generates text for low/medium prompts, but T023 (Logging) requires logging 'simulated token counts' for this path. No task exists to calculate token counts for the rule-based expansion output. The consumer (Logging) requires an artifact (Token Count) that the producer (Expansion) does not emit.

T032 (Stratified Regression) depends on 'visual domain' metadata. The plan states this is conditional on metadata existence. However, T006 (Data Loader) does not include a task to validate the presence of this metadata field before downstream tasks assume its availability. If metadata is missing, T032 fails to produce the required stratified output, breaking the dependency chain for FR-010.
